# tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel (Resource)

A Bedrock tunnel: protected UDP ingress for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, forwarding to a backend set. Players connect to `allocated_cname`. Needs a plan with Geyser support (Premium or Enterprise) — on Pro the API answers `You cannot add any more bedrock tunnels.` **Not yet verified against the live API.**

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel" "bedrock" {
  network_id     = tcpshield_network.main.id
  name           = "bedrock"
  backend_set_id = tcpshield_backend_set.lobby.id
  location       = "FRA"
}

output "bedrock_address" {
  value = tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel.bedrock.allocated_cname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend_set_id` (Number) Backend set the tunnel forwards to.
- `location` (String) Ingress location, one of `tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel_locations` (e.g. `FRA`, `ANY`).
- `name` (String) Tunnel name.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the tunnel belongs to.

### Optional

- `proxy_protocol` (Number) PROXY protocol mode sent to the backends, as the panel's numeric code (`0` = off).

### Read-Only

- `allocated_cname` (String) Hostname players connect to.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric tunnel id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_bedrock_tunnel.bedrock <network_id>/<tunnel_id>
```
